blocks.text: Famous Places to Visit in Korea
Korea has a great number of attractive places to visit.
Some places are naturally beautiful such as Sorak Mountain while others are more historically aesthetic such as Bulguk Temple.
There are still those that were skillfully manmade like Independence Hall.
Perhaps several of the more popular attractions to visit in Korea are the Korean Folk Village in Suwon, the historical capital of GyeongJu, and the breathtaking Jeju Island.
